publication_binding: Caller-supplied publication identity plus mandatory frozen exact-source SHA256; no P1 checkout or independent remote Git membership claim.

stage_record.command: exact original command argv with absolute P1 executable/source/object paths

audit.owned_count: Determined from equality of all serialized/environment/declaration names; private/generated included. Not assumed to equal explicit declaration count.

runtime.packages: name -> {path,git_commit,expected_git_commit,compiled_lib}; Cli compiled_lib can be null

external_imports.scope: Entire actual audit import environment excluding target only; includes audit-only Lean.Util.CollectAxioms dependencies. Not claimed to be minimal source closure.
external_imports.relative_path: Dotted module mapped to path ending .olean; companions use same path plus .private or .server
external_imports.required_receiver_check: Require external module names exactly equal parsed P0_QUEUE_IMPORTS minus target; map each provider root and verify every olean and listed companion hash before reusing target object. Require every actual file record to equal its (provider,relative_path) entry in the pre-gate snapshot, require exact companion-set equality, and require snapshot completion no later than normal.started_utc. For each actual module, its relative_path must occur in exactly one pre-snapshot provider, equal to its unique post-gate provider.
external_imports.collection_timing: All provider olean files and existing private/server companions snapshotted before gates; actual audit-import files and companion sets required unchanged afterward.

optional_capsule_files: Only target object companions explicitly listed in RESULT.object_companions and CAPSULE_FILES.files.

manifest.files: Exhaustive payload file-records including RESULT; excludes itself, archive, and outer transport to avoid hash cycles.

transfer_receiver: Pin outer transport SHA via independent task argument; reject unsafe/duplicate tar entries; require exact manifest file set and byte/hash equality; verify all three gates, exact source/audit/runtime pins, full inventory and external remapped hashes. Do not recompile the accepted FastDet source.

pre_gate_external_snapshot.scope: Every provider *.olean and its existing .private/.server companions; only actual imports must remain unchanged afterward.
pre_gate_external_snapshot.receipt_binding: RESULT.external_pre_gate_snapshot and EXTERNAL_IMPORTS.external_pre_gate_snapshot must be the same file-record; snapshot is saved and frozen before normal starts.
